verdict.rationale: Fin exposes a programmatic Agent API and Node/TypeScript SDK (intercom-fin-docs-3, intercom-fin-gh-3) that allows calling Fin from external code/services, which supports headless/CI-style automation, and webhooks (intercom-fin-docs-6) enable event-driven automation without a UI. However, there is no documented CI-specific tooling (e.g., a CLI test runner, GitHub Action, or exit-code-based automation harness) and the orchestration endpoints needed for autonomous agent-style headless runs are only in a Preview API (intercom-fin-docs-4). missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD integration or GitHub Action, documented headless test/run mode with exit codes, independent confirmation of automation reliability outside preview APIs.
